library_name: Adobe Stock QC Agent research sources

sources.title: Content moderation in Adobe Stock
sources.scope: Overall moderation criteria: technical quality, IP compliance, commercial value, metadata, uniqueness; refusal reasons include technical issues, release issues, IP, metadata and generative-AI anomalies.
sources.notes: Public overview; does not reveal complete internal moderation algorithms.

sources.title: Quality and technical issues behind content refusal
sources.scope: Focus at 100%, blur, sharpening artifacts, noise, exposure, white balance, color fringing, masking, composition, video stability, vector path quality.
sources.notes: Search snippets from some regional/localized page variants displayed 2026-09-02, while the opened HelpX page content showed 2026-06-11; refresh canonical page/locale before treating update stamp as authoritative.

sources.title: Common reasons for content refusal
sources.scope: Non-compliance, IP, technical quality; photos can be over/underexposed, soft, poorly white-balanced, heavily edited/oversharpened, dusty, over/undersaturated; video-specific concerns.
sources.notes: Search snippets from some regional/localized page variants displayed 2026-09-02, while the opened HelpX page content showed 2026-06-11; refresh canonical page/locale before treating update stamp as authoritative.

sources.title: Generative AI content guidelines
sources.scope: Commercial rights, prohibited prompt/title/keyword references, required AI label, fictional people/property checkbox conditions, releases, content classification.

sources.title: Submit AI-generated content to Adobe Stock
sources.scope: Pre-submission review for anatomy, proportions, visual intent, releases, unique value; AI content cannot be Illustrative Editorial.

sources.title: Adobe Stock generative AI FAQ
sources.last_updated: Not captured in snippet; recheck live page
sources.scope: Required AI checkbox; fictional checkbox when AI-made content resembles a person/property but wasn't based on a real person; human/animal anatomy; upscaling; similar iteration advice.
sources.notes: Use canonical page and refresh its current update stamp during scheduled knowledge refresh.

sources.title: Content policy for artist names, known people, fictional characters
sources.scope: Further detail on prohibited prompts and references for generative AI.

sources.title: Technical and legal requirements for photo submission
sources.scope: Photo JPEG, 4-100MP, max 45MB, sRGB, clean of watermarks/timestamps/branding, sharp and well-lit, people and property releases/IP.

sources.title: Technical requirements for PNG submissions
sources.scope: PNG, 4-100MP, max 45MB, sRGB, true transparency, no watermark/timestamps/branding, clarity/details/crop/borders/scaling.

sources.title: PNG best practices
sources.scope: Crop excess space, clean isolation, shadow treatment, true transparency, no duplicate same content as PNG and JPEG.

sources.title: Technical requirements for vector submissions
sources.scope: Vector file max 45MB, artboard 15-65MP, RGB, artboard offset (0,0), clean scalable/editable paths.

sources.title: Technical requirements for video submissions
sources.scope: Video formats, duration, file size, frame rate, resolution, native frame size; video implementation is future phase.

sources.title: Tips for effective titles and keywords
sources.scope: Brief accurate title, ideally under 70 characters; up to 49 keywords on this page; ordering importance, relevance, first ten priority.

sources.title: Model release overview
sources.scope: Recognizable people may be identified by face, voice, tattoos, clothing or surroundings; release is required.

sources.title: Property release requirements
sources.scope: Private homes, artwork, street murals, recognizable products/designs, protected objects; cases depend on focus and context.

sources.title: Known restrictions
sources.scope: Dynamic list of prohibited or restricted designs, locations, logos and works. Adobe explicitly says list is updated periodically and is not all-inclusive.

sources.title: Account and submission guidelines
sources.scope: High-level technical, legal, creative and submission standards.

sources.title: Unveiling Perceptual Artifacts: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Interpretable AI-Generated Image Detection
sources.scope: Research on localized, explainable artifact annotations; warns current binary AI-image detectors often rely on uninterpretable features and lack fine-grained evidence.

sources.title: AIGIQA-20K: A Large Database for AI-Generated Image Quality Assessment
sources.scope: Subjective assessment database covering perceived image quality and text-image alignment for AI-generated images.

sources.title: Multi-dimensional AI-generated image quality assessment via joint text template and multi-granularity similarity
sources.scope: Research framing AI-generated image quality in terms including quality, authenticity, and text-image correspondence; research context only, not Adobe policy.
